tests: p66_20260927T045501 (N, R3; levels 1, 8; AIPerf rejected --warmup-request-count 0 on every level; the Guardrails server did not start: the P19 environment has no server packages)
p66_20260927T1049xx (N, R3; levels 1, 8 with 2c requests; Part D 4 items x 1 round at c=1 and under a c=16 background)
summary: Two harness tests before this file was written. The first found: (1) AIPerf 0.11.0 rejects --warmup-request-count 0, so the flag was dropped (no per-level warm-up is AIPerf's default); (2) the Guardrails 0.23.0 environment used by P19 has the library but not its server extra, so a new environment (gr0230srv) was made with the same package versions plus the server extra (nine packages added, none changed; freeze kept). In the second test: N-arm health 0.878; G2 on N: adversarial and clean both answered with 1 NIM call each; G2 on R3: adversarial blocked with 1 NIM call (input rail), clean passed with 3 NIM calls; R3 at c=8 used exactly 3 NIM calls per request; the request payloads of each level had the same sha256 on N and R3 (G5); one of R3's 50 warm-up prompts drew the refusal (counted by the harness; none in the measured test levels); Part D verdicts carried the judge's completion tokens from the server's call log ([3, 3] on R3). The server-CPU sampler read 0 in this test because it re-created its process objects every second; it was fixed to keep one object per process and checked on a single-core busy loop started through the same venv launcher (98.5-100% per sample). The raw-export parsing (refusal count, errors by status, passed-only throughput) was rewritten after reading the export's real format and checked offline on this test's files.
